questions.subtopic: Round Table Cover with 6 Equal Designs
questions.question: A circular table cover of radius 28 cm is divided into six equal 60-degree sectors. In each sector, a straight chord joins its two arc endpoints, forming a circular segment between the chord and the arc. Find the combined area of these six segments. (Use pi = 22/7 and sqrt(3) = 1.7)
questions.explanation: Each design corresponds to a segment of angle 360 / 6 = 60 degrees. Area of 1 sector = (60/360) * (22/7) * 28 * 28 = (1/6) * 22 * 4 * 28 = 2464 / 6 = 1232 / 3 cm^2. Area of 1 equilateral triangle = (sqrt(3)/4) * 28^2 = (1.7 / 4) * 784 = 1.7 * 196 = 333.2 cm^2. Area of 1 design segment = 1232/3 - 333.2 = 410.67 - 333.2 = 77.47 cm^2. Total area of 6 designs = 6 * (1232/3 - 333.2) = 2464 - 1999.2 = 464.8 cm^2.

questions.subtopic: Inscribed Square in Circle Area Ratio
questions.question: A square is inscribed in a circle of radius r. What is the ratio of the area of the circle to the area of the square?
